after: post-confirmation edge / drift monitoring is a later roadmap stage (Edge/Drift Monitoring); Paper forward evidence (PAPER-R1 linkage) is not authorized and is not part of this contract
decay_rule: FORWARD_DECAYED when the forward net alpha < decay_min_ratio x the in-sample net alpha
efficacy_rule: once, at the planned end: the full P2-F0 battery on the forward window (window.kind = forward). Forward local pass = battery verdict FORWARD_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED or PROVISIONAL, i.e. no invalid / reject / fragile / insufficient effect, with S01 = Holm across the registered set at 0.05 on the forward net alpha; plateau and global search controls do not apply to a pre-registered set; strict = PROVISIONAL-level (every deterministic robustness rule also held)
eligibility: only an in-sample verdict of FORWARD_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED or PROVISIONAL; at most max_set_size candidates per forward test, all frozen and registered (forward_registration) before the forward window's first day
harm_rule: weekly looks; stop with FORWARD_REJECTED when the one-sided p of mean < 0 (core test on the negated series) is below the O'Brien-Fleming-type spending increment of that look; there is NO early stop for success
length_formula: n = ceil(((z_{1-alpha} + z_power) * sd_is / (haircut * mean_is))^2 * deff_is), clamped to [min_days, max_days]; infeasible when the unclamped n > max_days (verdict stays FORWARD_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED with note forward_infeasible)

power_reality.consequence: with the 120-day cap and the 0.5 haircut, every plausible edge (S <= 4) is forward_infeasible; a candidate becomes feasible only when its in-sample estimate is large, i.e. most likely inflated. The forward length cap is therefore an OWNER decision (collector horizon), recorded here as open, not a statistical parameter
power_reality.open_owner_decision: forward test maximum duration and whether a plausibility-based lower bound on n applies
power_reality.rule: days for 80 % power (one-sided 5 %) to detect an annualized net-alpha Sharpe S with ~1 observation per day: n = (2.486 * sqrt(365) / S)^2, before the dependence factor

verdicts.FORWARD_CONSISTENT: survived one pre-registered forward test; the strongest P2-F label; not proof and not a deployment approval
verdicts.FORWARD_DECAYED: forward local pass but forward mean < decay_min_ratio x in-sample mean
verdicts.FORWARD_REJECTED: harm stop, or the forward battery verdict is REJECTED / INVALID_EVIDENCE

window: starts at the first eligible sealed day after BOTH the P2-D0 forward-untouched boundary (day 29 for round 1) and the latest label end read by any in-sample evidence of the round (label-tail rule); consecutive eligible days; never W3
